explication: Power Platform Skills is a plugin marketplace for agent-driven Power Platform development. A user installs a plugin, invokes a skill through Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, supplies natural-language intent, and receives generated or deployed apps, sites, flows, widgets, or mobile packages. The major stages are plugin installation, intent-driven generation, deterministic validation, platform provisioning/deployment, and telemetry. Evidence is strongest for mobile, model-app, and Power Pages helpers; several plugin capabilities are represented from the README and tree without sampled implementation.
